For engagement tracking Engagement use EntityType=1 as the engagement reports are all tied to accounts.  Ensure that the EntityUid matches the Uid for the corresponding account that you want to tie the event to.  For example, lets say you wanted to track engagement for a particular important action that a user takes using your product.   Name the action performed in the Title, select 1 for Entity Type and make sure the EntityUid matches the account that performed the action.
